flatten_lora_checkpoint: run the CLI to flatten LoRA weights from a PEFT checkpoint into a merged base model
init_model_from_pretrained: build a ModelFlattener that loads a pretrained causal LM and tokenizer in float16
merge_and_unload_peft: run load_and_flatten_checkpoint to merge LoRA adapters and save the flattened model
save_merged_model: run the CLI to save a merged model and tokenizer to a new directory under the checkpoint path
review_ModelFlattener_class: review the ModelFlattener class and its init_model and load_and_flatten_checkpoint methods
